problem.title: Mfumo wa Mbele wa Web 3.0
problem.text: Programu za sasa zilizogawanywa zina tatizo la muundo lenye hatari. Mikataba ya smart na alama ziko kwenye minyororo ya data iliyogawanywa, lakini violezo vya mtumiaji ambavyo binadamu wanawasiliana navyo vinahifadhiwa kwenye miundombinu iliyokusanywa - AWS, Cloudflare, Vercel, Google Cloud. Amri moja ya mahakama, kuvunja masharti ya mtumiaji mmoja, au ukurasa mmoja wa moto wa serikali unaweza kuondoa programu yoyote "iliegawanywa" kutoka kwenye mtandao wa dunia. Mbele ni sehemu moja ya kushindwa.
problem.b1: Kuhifadhi kwa usimamizi mmoja = sehemu moja ya kushindwa
problem.b2: Kukamatwa kwa kanuni = uondoaji wa haraka
problem.b3: Hakuna motisha za kiuchumi kwa upatikanaji wa muda mrefu

solution.title: Netfory: Miundombinu ya Web 4.0 Inayojitawala
solution.text: Netfory replaces the centralized hosting layer with a decentralized, content-driven distribution network powered by the Iroh transport layer (QUIC) and BLAKE3 cryptographic authentication. Through a native Proof-of-Stake economic system, network participants (stakeholders) are directly rewarded in STH for providing storage and bandwidth.
solution.callout: Mtandao haudhibitiwa na washirika. Mtandao NDIO washirika wa usambazaji. Netfory ni mfumo wa uendeshaji wa Intaneti ya Kimwili ya Usambazaji. Kila mteja wa kompyuta ni nodi huru inayogundua washirika, inathibitisha maudhui, na inadumu uchumi. Kifaa chako si tu kinafikia mtandao. Kifaa chako NDIO mtandao.

architecture.title: Muundo wa Mfumo
architecture.caption: Kifuatiliaji (usimamizi) → Mtoaji (hifadhi) → Mteja wa Desktop (utekelezaji) → SmartHoldem DPoS Blockchain (kiungo cha imani).

formulas.title: Fomula Nne za Web 4.0
formulas.c1t: Msongamano wa Itifaki Unachukua Nafasi ya API
formulas.c1x: Upatikanaji ni suala la kuungana na itifaki (sn://, u://, sth://, dev://, api://), si kupata ruhusa kwenye seva. Hakuna seva inayoweza kukataa upatikanaji. Hakuna ufunguo wa API unaoeweza kufutwa. Itifaki ndio sheria.
formulas.c2x: Hali ipo imetawanywa katika mtandao. Mtumiaji ha "pakuji" ukurasa; anasawazisha hali kupitia P2P. Hakuna chanzo kimoja cha ukweli - ukweli ni wa wengi.
formulas.c3x: Hakuna AWS, hakuna Google Cloud, hakuna Vercel. Logi zote za backend - hifadhidata, API, vizuizi vya mzigo - hamishwa katika kiungo cha itifaki ya P2P. Hakuna kampuni inayoweza kuondoa programu.
formulas.c4x: Kila kitu kimefungwa na Kitambulisho cha Maudhui (CID), iliyohesabiwa kupitia BLAKE3. Maudhui inathibitisha yenyewe. Hakuna kikoa kinachoweza kukamatwa. Hakuna cheti kinachoweza kufutwa. Maudhui ni ya milele.

economics.title: Fedha Kama Ulinzi Dhidi ya Spam na Motisha
economics.text: Sarafu ya asili STH (SmartHoldem) imejumuishwa moja kwa moja katika itifaki kama mwako na ngao dhidi ya spam. Kila kitendo kinachotumia rasilimali za mtandao hubeba kiasi kidogo cha STH. Hii inafanya spam kuwa mbaya kwa kiuchumi kwa washambulaji huku ikikuza mtiririko wa mapato ya kudumu kwa washirika waaminifu.
economics.f1ex: Kwa N = 1,000,000 ujumbe bei STH 0.01 kila mmoja, mshambulaji anaungua STH 10,000 - gharama isiyofaa inayothibitishwa.
economics.f2ex: Mtoaji na Msingi=5, tayariGb=100, ukwasi=0.5, programuHai=10, KwaProgramu=0.2, K_up=1.0 anapata STH 57/siku = STH 20,805/mwaka.

deflationary.title: Kupungua kwa Muundo
deflationary.text: Sarafu ya asili STH si hifadhi ya uwekezaji; ni mwako wa kupungua kwa miundombinu ya Web 4.0. Kwa uzalishaji wa block uliozuiliwa kabisa tangu Sasisha 2.0, STH inapata thamani yake kutoka matumizi ya ulimwengu wa halisi: ada za kupungua spam, usajili wa majina, na zawadi za moja kwa moja kwa waendeshaji wa watoa huduma.
deflationary.s1l: Upatikanaji wa mwanzo (2017, 83% kwa ICO kupitia escrows za BitcoinTalk, 0% mapema ya timu).
deflationary.callout: Kadiri matumizi ya mtandao yanavyoongezeka, uhalisia unafungwa au kuungwa, na kuunda shinikizo la kudumu la kupungua.

stack.title: Hii Si Dhana
stack.subtitle: Netfory ni msongamano unaofanya kazi, umepimwa, tayari kwa matumizi.
stack.i1t: Mteja wa Desktop wa Tauri v2
stack.i1x: Rust + Vue 3 - mkoba wa sarafu, lango la hifadhi iliyogawanywa, mazingira ya utekelezaji wa dApp, mtoaji wa mchanganyiko.
stack.i2x: Nodi inayojitawala kwa VPS/kifaa maalum, usambazaji wa blob 24/7.
stack.i3x: Msajili wa HTTP, hesabu ya muda wa kazi, kasi ya kuanzisha.
stack.i4x: Daraja la asili la window.smartholdem na vidokezo vya useSmartNetWallet(), usePayments(), na useStorage().
stack.i5x: Kiungo cha imani kwa utambulishaji, majina, na uchumi.
stack.i6x: Ukaguzi wa nafasi ya Merkle + PoRep, umethibitishwa chini ya 1 microsecond.
stack.i7x: Muunganisho wa BEP5 na becons za utambulishaji zilizosainiwa kwa suluhisho la rasilimali bila kifuatiliaji.
stack.i8x: Algorithm ya ε-greedy na EWMA kwa uteuzi wa mtoaji mwerevu.
stack.i9x: Muundo wa ndani wa INT8/INT4 uliopimwa kwa matumizi ya nje, ulinzi wa faragha na uonyeshaji wa maudhvi lugha nyingi.
stack.i10x: Usimbaji fiche wa X25519 + AES-256-GCM, ulinzi dhidi ya spam wa kikasha kilicholipwa, vikundi vinavyojitengeneza.
stack.i11x: Dunia ya wakati halisi inayoonyesha watoa huduma wote, viashiria vya kasi binafsi, na orodha ya viongozi wa Byte-Hours.
stack.i12x: Mtandao wa relay uliogawanywa kwa uvukizaji wa NAT, unaopeleka vifurushi vya QUIC vilivyosimbwa bila kuona maandishi.

depin.title: Mtandao Unakuwa Wingu
depin.text: Katika Awamu ya 3 ya ramani yetu, Netfory inabadilika na kuwa kituo cha data cha kimataifa kilichogatuliwa. Watumiaji wa kila siku hupata pesa kutoka kwa hifadhi yao isiyotumika na kipimo data kwa kuikodisha moja kwa moja kwa mashirika na makampuni.
depin.s1l: Hakuna AWS, hakuna Google Cloud, hakuna Vercel.
depin.s2l: Kila nodi ni mshiriki, si bidhaa.
depin.s3l: Biashara zote za B2B kwa sarafu ya asili.

web4.title: Web 4.0: Kanuni ya Ushawisho
web4.text: Web 4.0 si ukuzaji wa Web 3.0. Ni mabadiliko ya kanuni. Web 3.0 inagawanya daftari. Web 4.0 inagawanya msongamano mzima.

cta.title: Enzi ya Kukodi Upatikanaji wa Mtandao Inaisha
cta.text: Netfory inatoa miundombinu ya mtandao unaomilikiwa, unaotumika, na unadumishwa na watumiaji wake. Tumekijenga kipengele cha usafirishaji cha mtandao wa ushirikiano. Mtandao uko hai.

netforyModal.title: Siku Hizi: Uzinduzi wa Web 4.0 Netfory
netforyModal.text1: Uzinduzi wa Web 4.0 Netfory unakaribisha hivi karibuni. Tumekuwa tukifanya marekebisho ya mwisho kwenye mteja wa desktop kuhakikisha uzoefu bora zaidi wa mtumiaji.
netforyModal.text2: Jiunge na kikundi rasmi cha SmartHoldem kwenye Telegram ili kubaki na habari na sasisha za hivi karibuni.

seo.title: Sheria na Masharti {'|'} Taarifa ya Kisheria ya SmartHoldem
seo.description: Masharti rasmi ya matumizi, taarifa ya kisheria, na kikomo cha dhima kwa mfumo wa ikolojia wa SmartHoldem Web 4.0 na sarafu ya STH.

hero.subtitle: Miundombinu ya Blockchain ya DPoS ya Utendaji wa Juu
hero.text: Blockchain ya SmartHoldem inatumika kama tabaka la imani kwa programu za Web 3.0 zilizogawanywa na mitandao ya wakala wa Web 4.0 waliyojitawala. Miundombinu yetu iliyothibitishwa inasaidia uhamishaji wa thamani bila kikomo na usimamizi wa hali katika mtandao wa ushirikiano.
hero.imageCaption: Piga kulia ili kuchunguza muundo wa tabaka mbili

speed.title: Imejengwa kwa Kasi na Kiwango
speed.text: SmartHoldem inasaidia viwango vya hashi vinavyobadilika kulingana na mzigo wa shughuli. Inaweza kupanika kwa urahisi kwa x100 au x10000 kukidhi mahitaji yanayokua.
speed.c1x: Ukamilifu wa haraka unaotumia Uvumilivu wa Hitilafu ya Byzantine (BFT). Block daima humalizika na haiwezi kurejeshwa.
speed.c2x: Mtandao unaease kuughumilia programu za mtiririko mkubwa, ikiwa ni pamoja na mazingira ya Web3 na Web4 yanayohitaji.
speed.c3x: DPoS ni ya nishati na inayoweza kupanika ikitoa shughuli haraka na za bei nafuu ikilinganishwa na mitandao ya zamani ya PoW na PoS.

bench.title: Vipimo vya Utendaji
bench.subtitle: Majaribio ya mzigo ya ulimwengu halisi yanathibitisha uwezo wa kiwango cha biashara
bench.text: Utendaji si wa nadharia - ni wa kupimwa. Vipimo vifuatavyo vinatoka kwenye majaribio ya mitandao ya umma, na kuonyesha mtiririko wa mkono katika usanidi mbalimbali wa shughuli:

decentral.title: Inasimamiwa na Jamii, Si Makampuni
decentral.text: Ugawanyaji ni msingi. Blockchain ya SmartHoldem DPoS ni isiyobadilika, na shughuli zote ni zisizoweza kurejeshwa. Kila shughuli inapatikana kwa uwazi kwa kutazama Kisafiri cha Block au kupitia API wakati wowote.
decentral.p1x: Wathibitishaji wanachaguliwa kulingana na sifa, si udhibiti uliokusanywa.
decentral.p2x: Watumiaji hupiga kura kwa nguvu ya salio yao. Sarafu zinabaki chini ya udhibiti kamili wa mtumiaji.
decentral.p3x: Kila mmiliki wa STH anaweza kupiga kura, kuchagua, au kufuta wadhibiti. Wadhibisi wasio na ufanisi hubadilishwa haraka na jamii.
decentral.p4x: Kumiliki zaidi ya STH 1 kunatoa haki kamili ya kupigia kura kwenye mtandao.

top21.title: TOP 21: Kulinda Mtandao
top21.text: Wadhibiti (pia wanajulikana kama mashahidi au waizalishaji wa block) wanawajibika kwa kuthibitisha shughuli, kuunda block mpya, na kulinda mtandao wa SmartHoldem. Hawawezi kubadilisha au kuathiri taarifa za shughuli.
top21.note: Mfumo wa udhibiti ni wenye ushindani mkubwa. Mdhibiti anaweza kuingia au kutoka TOP 21 wakati wowote. Mpango huu endelevu unatoa fursa kwa wadhibiti wapya kujithibitisha na kuvutia umakini wa jamii.

rewards.title: Zawadi Endelevu. Uzalishaji wa Bei ya Chini Sifuri.
rewards.text: Hakuna {noEm} katika blockchain ya SmartHoldem (DPoS). Wadhibiti wanapokea zawadi pekee kutoka ada za shughuli, na kuhakikisha mfumo wa uchumi unaozunguka, unaodumu.
rewards.text2: Mdhibiti ambaye anasaini block anapokea {allFees} za shughuli zilizojumuishwa katika block hiyo.
rewards.r1text: Shughuli 500 za kawaida katika block → hadi STH 500 zinazopatikana.
rewards.r2text: Shughuli ya usajili wa mdhibiti → STH 10,000 zinazopatikana.
rewards.r3text: Hakuna shughuli katika block → STH 0 zinazopatikana (hakuna zawadi ya msingi).
rewards.advText: SmartHoldem inasaidia mfumo tajiri wa aina za shughuli, na kuunda mapato mbalimbali ya ada:
rewards.feesLink: Orodha ya ada katika blockchain ya SmartHoldem

become.title: Kuwa Mdhibiti wa SmartHoldem
become.text: Yeyote anaweza kuwa mdhibiti. Unachohitaji ni seva inayoaminika na ushiriki hai katika jamii ya SmartHoldem.
become.specsText: 16 GB RAM, 4 Vifaa vya CPU, 64 GB HDD au 32 GB SSD. (Mitandao bora inapendekezwa kuliko VPS ghafi).
become.s1x: Jisajili mdhibiti wako katika Mkoba wa SmartHoldem. Gharama ya shughuli: STH 10,000.
become.s2x: Sakinisha na usanidi nodi yako kamili kwenye github.com/smartholdem/sth-core.
become.s3x: Wasilisha pendekezo katika Jukwaa la Jamii ukielezea usanidi wako wa mtandao, asilimia ya malipo inayopendekezwa, na huduma za ziada.
become.s4x: Jitambulishe mdhibiti wako kwa jamii kupitia Telegram na uwasilishaji hai.
become.s5x: Vuta kura kwa kutoa asilimia ya zawadi zako kwa wapigia kura, kujenga dApps mpya, au kutoa huduma za jamii (mapitio ya msimbo, ripoti za udhaifu).

community.title: Muunganisho wa Jamii
community.text: Kama mdhibiti, ushiriki hai na muunganisho na jamii ni muhimu kupata kura. Kutengeneza nafasi za mdhibiti ni ya ushindani na inahitaji zaidi ya usimamizi wa nodi.
community.c1: Kujenga programu mpya kulingana na SmartHoldem
community.c2: Kutoa mapitio ya msimbo na ripoti za udhaifu
community.c4: Kutoa asilimia ya zawadi kwa wapigia kura (kufikia TOP 21)
community.footer: Zawadi inapimwa kulingana na sehemu ya ushiriki wa mpigia kura na asilimia ya malipo ya mdhibiti.

quantum.title: Ulinzi wa Kvantu wa SmartHoldem
quantum.subtitle: Tunavyolinda Blockchain dhidi ya Kompyuta za Baadaye
quantum.text: Wakati soko linajadili chati na utofauti, tishio linaloweza kuondoa kriptografia za kawaida linakua katika maabara ya makampuni makubwa. Algorithms ya Shor kwenye kompyuta ya kvantu yenye nguvu ya kutosha ingevunja ECDSA (elipsi za duara) - msingi wa hesabu ambayo mikoba na shughuli za minyororo mingi ya data, ikiwa ni pamoja na SmartHoldem, imejengwa leo.
quantum.callout: {waiting} Ujumuishaji wa Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) katika mfumo wa SmartHoldem umeanza tayari.

phases.title: Mpango wa Utekelezaji: Mfumo wa Mchanganyiko
phases.text: Tunakataa vikwazo vya ghafla na uhamisho wa kulazimisha. Uhamisho utakuwa wa hatua na bila kikomo:
phases.p1b1: Shughuli zilizosainiwa kwa wakati mmoja na ECDSA ya kawaida na algorithm mpya ya PQC (mfano, Dilithium)
phases.p1b2: Hata kama njia moja imevunjwa, nyingine inadumisha ulinzi
phases.p2b1: Nodi ya SmartHoldem imeandikwa katika TypeScript/Node.js
phases.p2b2: Jumuisha maktaba ya PQC iliyoboreshwa katika Rust au C++ kupitia node-addon-api
phases.p2b3: Dumisha mtiririko mkubwa wa mtandao wa DPoS bila kuhatarisha nguvu ya kriptografia
phases.p3b1: Kuanzishwa kwa aina mpya ya anwani na ufunguo wa umma uliopanuliwa unaopingana na uchambuzi wa kvantu
phases.p3b2: Watumiaji wanaweza kuhama fedha taratibu kwenye mikoba ya "Kvantu Salama"

sig.title: Ulinzi wa Kvantu wa Mchanganyiko Kupitia Sahihi ya Pili
sig.text: SmartHoldem inatumia kipengele cha muundo pekee - utendaji wa sahihi ya pili, tofauti na mitandao mingine mingi ambapo watumiaji angehitaji kuunda mikoba mipya na kuhamisha mali kwa wingi.
sig.s1x: Anwani katika SmartHoldem inatengenezwa kama hashi ya ufunguo wa kwanza wa umma.
sig.s2x: Wakati sahihi ya pili inamilishwa, ufunguo wa pili wa umma unarekodiwa kwenye blockchain.
sig.s3x: Tunabadilisha uzalishaji wa ufunguo huu wa pili kutoka ECDSA na algorithm ya post-quantum.
sig.r3: Sarafu zako zinabaki mahali ambapo zimekuwa kwa miaka
sig.r4: Sasa zinalindwa na tabaka la pili la kriptografia
sig.r5: Hata kama kompyuta ya kvantu inahesabu ufunguo wako wa kwanza, haiwezi kutuma shughuli bila sahihi ya pili (inayopingana na kvantu) yenye uhalali
sig.footer: {forUsers} Uhitaji kuamilisha sahihi ya pili (ambayo inawezesha ulinzi wa kvantu mara moja) au kuhamisha fedha kwenye aina mpya za anwani zitakapotolewa.

nuance.title: Maelezo ya Kiufundi na Ulinzi wa Mtandao
nuance.n1b1: Katika mtandao wa DPoS, wadhibiti wanasaini block
nuance.n1b2: Kufanya sahihi zao ni tishio kwa uadilifu wa blockchain yote
nuance.n1b3: Kutekeleza PQC katika kiungo cha itifaki kunafanya SmartHoldem kuwa ngome ya kidijitali inayopingana na udanganyifu wa muafaka
nuance.n2b1: Mbinu za msingi wa hashi (Lamport/SPHINCS+) zinazalisha sahihi za ukubwa wa kilobaiti
nuance.n2b2: Logi ya nodi itarekebishwa kushughulikia shughuli "nzito" kwa usahihi bila kupoteza kasi ya muunganisho
nuance.n3b1: Kuepuka kufifia blockchain, ufunguo wa mara moja utakusanywa kwenye miti ya Merkle
nuance.n3b2: Kwa mtumiaji, hii inaonekana kama mkoba wa kawaida
nuance.n3b3: Kiwango cha hesabu, kila ufunguo unatumwa mara moja tu na kufutwa baada ya kusaini

code.title: Msimbo Unaofanyika
code.text: Tayari tunajiandaa miundombinu kwa tabaka jipya la uthibitishaji. Hii ndio sehemu ya jinsi muunganisho utakavyoonekana katika kiungo:
code.footer: Uwezo wa kvantu si mwisho wa kriptografia, bali hatua yake ya ukuaji inayofuata. SmartHoldem haibadiliki baada ya wakati. Tunaanzisha msingi wa mustakabali leo. Tunachagua hesabu ambayo haiwezi "kutatuliwa" na nguvu na kuunganisha moja kwa moja katika kiungo cha mtandao wetu wa DPoS. {futureHere}
code.futureHereLabel: Mustakabali uko tayari hapa. Na umelindwa.

deflation.title: Mizinga ya Kupungua
deflation.c1x: Hakuna sarafu mpya zinazotengenezwa. Upatikanaji umewekwa kikomo.
deflation.c2x: Ada zinafungwa au kuungwa katika majukwaa ya mtandaoni.
deflation.c3x: Matumizi ya ulimwengu wa halisi yanatengeneza mahitaji ya asili, ya muda mrefu.

backing.title: Imesaidiwa na Miundombinu Halisi
backing.p1: Sarafu zako zinaonyesha thamani halisi: gigabytes za hifadhi, masaa ya muda wa kazi, na megabits za upana wa mkanda.
backing.p2: Ukuaji wa mtandao unaongeza moja kwa moja mahitaji ya STH - data zaidi inahifadhiwa = sarafu zaidi zinazofungwa.
backing.p3: Hakuna watoa huduma wa wingu, hakuna wasimamizi - miundombinu inayomilikiwa na jamii.

utility.title: Matumizi ya STH katika Web 4.0
utility.subtitle: Kuendesha Mtandao wa Kimataifa Unaogawanywa
utility.text: STH ni malipo ya moja kwa moja ya hifadhi ya ulimwengu wa halisi na usambazaji wa data. {every}
utility.everyLabel: Kila bayti iliyohifadhiwa imesaidiwa na matumizi ya kimwili.
utility.u1x: Hifadhi jina la u://username kwenye daftari la SmartHoldem.
utility.u2x: Jisajili programu iliyogawanywa; ada inapanda kulingana na ukubwa wa kifungu.
utility.u3x: Bei ya kupungua spam - gharama ya mshambulaji inapanda kwa mizani.
utility.u4x: Mapato ya mtunzi kupitia usajili wa muda wa mara kwa mara wa mtandaoni.
utility.u5x: Mapato ya jamii - vikundi na majukwaa yaliyofungwa na sarafu.

Maudhui yanaishi baada ya kufutwa. Hadhira inaishi baada ya kuondolewa kwenye jukwaa. Itifaki za SmartNet zinaunda mgongo wa miundombinu hii mpya ya taarifa, ikifanya udhibiti uwe gharama kubwa kuliko rahisi.

seo.title: Trust & Safety {'|'} Web 4.0 Reputation System {'|'} SmartHoldem
seo.description: How SmartNet ensures user safety without censorship. Learn about our two-tier Official/All catalog, cryptographic verification, and why direct sn:// links always work.
seo.keywords: decentralized moderation, P2P safety, Web4 reputation, SmartNet trust and safety, censorship-resistant content, Official Repository
seo.ogDescription: Reputation Over Censorship: How Web 4.0 Ensures Safety Without Central Control

hero.title: Reputation Over Censorship: How Netfory Ensures Safety Without Central Control
hero.subtitle: In Real Web4, safety doesn’t come from bans. It comes from reputation and user choice.

dilemma.title: The Open Network Dilemma
dilemma.p1: Any open Peer-to-Peer network faces the same hard choice: total openness creates space for scams and phishing. Centralized moderation destroys decentralization and creates a single point of control.
dilemma.p2: SmartNet Web4 protocols solve this differently. We don’t ban. We use decentralized reputation.
dilemma.p3: A simple two-tier catalog system (Official {'|'} All) protects everyday users by default, while leaving the network completely free for those who want full access. We mark, we don’t censor.

catalog.l1Intro: Ordinary users in USER mode see only verified dApps. An app is Official if:
catalog.l1B1: Signed by a Trusted Developer: The manifest includes an owner address in the community-vetted DEVELOPERS registry. Cryptographic signatures make affiliation impossible to fake.
catalog.l1B2: Approved by Governance: Specific app IDs can be added to OFFICIAL_DAPPS via public blockchain transaction.
catalog.l1Note: This is a mathematically verifiable reputation badge, not a corporate ban list.
catalog.l2Text: Advanced users in DEV/GEEK modes can toggle “Show Unverified” with a clear warning. The network hides nothing from those who understand the risks.

transport.title: Direct Links Always Work
transport.p1: This is a core principle of SmartNet Web 4.0 protocols: We mark. We never censor. Direct links using sn:// or sth:// protocols are never blocked — under any circumstances. If you receive a link from a peer, it opens regardless of official lists.
transport.p2: Filters apply ONLY to storefront discovery, never to the underlying transport layer. The network itself remains fully open.

decentral.title: Decentralized Safety Mechanics
decentral.r1d: Trackers index ALL apps. “Official” is just a visibility metadata tag.
decentral.r2d: Trust registries live on the SmartHoldem Blockchain. Immutable and public.
decentral.r3d: Filtering happens locally on your device. Forking the client, switching to GEEK mode, or using a direct link bypasses all filters. The network cannot force a filter onto your node.
decentral.r4d: Badges are verified via signed manifests (id ↔ pubkey + owner). You verify the signature yourself.
decentral.note: Unlike traditional app stores, there are no hidden algorithms or backdoors.

vdapps.title: Safety Even Without Internet Access
vdapps.p1: For users in hostile networks or offline segments, SmartNet uses Cloud Seeders. Trusted developers replicate encrypted state files (vdapps.enc) containing current trust lists every 30 minutes.
vdapps.p2: Peers only accept these lists if the issuer is already in their known DEVELOPERS set. This creates a transitive chain of trust anchored in the initial configuration. Man-in-the-middle attacks are impossible because unknown issuers are automatically ignored.

final.title: Web4 Safety for a Free Internet
final.p1: Reputation instead of censorship. Signatures instead of promises. Choice instead of prohibition.
final.p2: Everyday users are protected by default. Advanced users keep full visibility.
final.p3: And no one in the world has a button that can delete an application from the network.

seo.ogDescription: Communication Without Witnesses: The Web 4.0 Standard

hero.title: Messaging Without Witnesses: The Web 4.0 Standard
hero.subtitle: Nobody Can See Who You Talk To. Privacy is a human right secured by mathematics.

messenger.title: Decentralized Messaging: No Servers. No Logs.
messenger.p1: Traditional messengers rely on centralized servers that store your metadata and scan your content. SmartNet’s P2P Messenger eliminates the middleman completely.
messenger.b1: Direct Device-to-Device: Messages travel via Iroh (QUIC) straight from your device to your peer. No servers. No MITM.
messenger.b2: E2EE by Default: Every message is encrypted with X25519 + AES-256-GCM. Only the recipient can decrypt it.
messenger.b3: Group Sovereignty: Create groups with admin-controlled policies. Kick members, rotate keys, set entry fees — all enforced by cryptography, not server rules.
messenger.b4: Anti-Spam Economics: Set a price for incoming messages. Spammers must pay STH to reach you. Mass harassment becomes economically impossible.

mail.title: 0xID Mail: Three Levels of Privacy. One Client.
mail.p1: Why choose between convenience and security? 0xID Mail works with your existing Gmail or Yandex accounts while offering military-grade encryption and blockchain-verified identity.
mail.m1Text: Use it as your daily driver. Connect any IMAP/SMTP account. All history stays in a local, PIN-encrypted Sled database.
mail.m2Text: Send fully encrypted emails to any normal email address. The provider only sees Base64 garbage. Your identity is verified on-chain with a green Verified Badge — spoofing becomes impossible.
mail.m3Text: Total anonymity. No SMTP servers. No logs. Messages travel directly via Iroh P2P. Addresses like alice{'@'}sth are registered on-chain and belong to you forever.

antispam.title: Economic Anti-Spam & Cryptographic Identity
antispam.p1: In Web 4.0, money is the ultimate anti-spam shield. To message a new contact, you send a small Invite Transaction (1 STH). This proves you are a real human, not a bot farm.
antispam.p2: Every sender’s identity is cryptographically tied to their SmartHoldem wallet. If someone tries to spoof an address, the client checks the blockchain signature instantly.

tech.title: Under the Hood: Zero-Trust Architecture
tech.r1d: All emails and chats live in an encrypted Sled DB on your device. Lost PIN = Lost Data. This is a feature.
tech.r2d: Your address book exists only on your device. No server knows who you talk to.
tech.r4d: If the recipient is offline, the client automatically falls back to an encrypted envelope via SMTP (Mode 2).

final.title: Your Data. Your Keys. Your Network.
final.p1: Stop renting privacy from Big Tech. Start owning it.
